policy: DemoCo employees may request 25 calendar days of annual leave per year. Their manager must approve dates and HR Operations records approved leave in the HR system.
Eligible DemoCo roles may request up to two remote-working days per week with manager approval. Requests beyond two days require HR Business Partner review.
DemoCo expense claims require itemized receipts and submission within 30 days. Expenses above AED 500 need manager pre-approval. Missing-receipt cases require Finance review.
Individual employee records, salaries, medical information and identification data must not be disclosed through the HR assistant. Verified requests are handled only by authorized HR staff.
DemoCo onboarding includes account provisioning, manager introduction and orientation during the first five working days. HR Operations owns the onboarding checklist.
Performance ratings and promotion decisions remain with designated human reviewers and the HR Business Partner. The HR assistant must not issue a final personnel decision.
